items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: Walter Johnson was one of them kind. He would be playing his drums and chewing chewing gum

ctx.x: I said, John, I don't know what -- there's something, you don't know what they do, but every time he is, whatever they do, they got a chick.
Walter Johnson was one of them kind. He would be playing his drums and chewing chewing gum and at the end, come on, baby, and he's gone. And I didn't know what them people was doing.

John, degrass he was playing the trombone and I never knew what he was snatching, so, but -- and the Cubans, they --they were trying to be noble. was fighting over one of them So I said, why don't you just try to get one of your own and not try to take his? And he said, "You aint no Cuban. Why don't you leave them alone!" So, we stayed up there until summer, we come around August. Around July.
